# Rehearsal

> Tradability passports and protected swaps for tokenized stocks on Solana (xStocks and PreStocks). Before a trade, Rehearsal answers what the token legally is, how trustworthy the price is right now, and how much you could sell at your size. Then it builds a swap that reverts on-chain if the fill is worse than fair value, and writes a receipt into the transaction.

## For agents

- MCP server (Streamable HTTP, no key): https://rehearsal-stocklana.vercel.app/api/mcp
- Tools: passport, check_trade, build_protected_swap, verify_receipt, market_status, price_policy, prestocks_research, execution_report, agent_scorecard, list_stocks
- Skill: `npx skills add Clintobi/rehearsal`
- Rule of thumb: call passport before any trade; follow decision.action (proceed, reduce_size, wait, avoid); execute with build_protected_swap; verify with verify_receipt.

## REST (no key)

- OpenAPI: https://rehearsal-stocklana.vercel.app/api/v1/openapi.json
- GET /api/v1/passport?symbol=NVDAx&usd=1000&side=buy
- POST /api/v1/swap {symbol, usd, side, wallet, maxGapBps}
- GET /api/v1/certificate?sig=<signature>
- GET /api/v1/policy
- GET /api/v1/prestocks

## How prices are chosen

US regular session: Pyth Equity.US price read on-chain. Outside it (pre-market, after hours, overnight, weekends): the Lighter 24/7 perpetual mark for the same stock. Halted by Nasdaq or the issuer: no swap is built. Pre-IPO (PreStocks): the PreStocks mark, which is a valuation, not a market price.
